\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{algorithm}
\usepackage{algpseudocode}
\begin{document}
\begin{algorithm}
\caption{Widget search}\label{alg:ws}
\begin{algorithmic}[1]
\Require a list $L$ and a key $k$
\Ensure the index of $k$
\State $i \gets 0$
\For{each $x$ in $L$}
  \If{$x = k$}
    \State \Return $i$
  \ElsIf{$x > k$}
    \State \textbf{break}
  \Else
    \State $i \gets i + 1$
  \EndIf
\EndFor
\While{$i > 0$} \State $i \gets i - 1$ \EndWhile
\Function{Find}{$L, k$} \State \Call{Search}{$L$} \EndFunction
\State \Comment{done}
\end{algorithmic}
\end{algorithm}
Algorithm~\ref{alg:ws} searches.
\end{document}
